sources.title: bart-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview bart-baseis a transformer encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence model built by facebookthat corrupts text during pre-training and learns to reconstruct the original, enabling both generation and comprehension tasks. The model uses a bidirectional BERT-like encoder paired with an autoregressive GPT-like decoder architecture.
